scheme_name: Gopinath Munde Shetkari Apghat Suraksha Sanugrah Audhan Yojana
other_conditions: Registered farmer aged between 10 and 75 years.
Farmer must be registered in Maharashtra, evidenced by a 7/12 extract.
One family member of the farmer (who is not a registered account holder) is also eligible.
All 1.52 crore farmers of the state and one family member from their family are covered.
benefits_summary: Compensation up to Rs. 2 lakh for death and up to Rs. 2 lakh for various disability categories.
